The `preservation` rows were generated from the previous persistent worktree at `010ab431d92e4ce2339e9f9cf4c64c69c7836a77` (base aa82faa plus the carried final-assembly fixes). The same 17 payload/clock pairs were executed on this branch. Calculation, natal/MBTI table, selected-material, compatibility index/direction/individual-profile and major-transition signatures matched before updating any editorial output expectations.
